covers: STAR structure on: a behavioural answer has Situation, Task, Action and Result, from the CV only.

session.description: Interview for a data analyst role on the operations team.

documents.name: resume.txt
documents.text: Priya Rao. Data analyst, 4 years at Alder Foods. Built the weekly sales report in SQL and Power BI, used by the regional managers, which cut the time to produce it from 2 hours to 10 minutes. Found a duplicate-order error in the warehouse feed and worked with the warehouse team to fix it.

tail.speaker: them
tail.text: TELL ME ABOUT A TIME YOU IMPROVED A PROCESS AT WORK

question: TELL ME ABOUT A TIME YOU IMPROVED A PROCESS AT WORK
mustInclude: has one bullet each starting with the words Situation, Task, Action and Result, in that order
tells the story of the weekly sales report or the duplicate-order error, in the first person
any result it gives is one the resume states, such as 2 hours to 10 minutes
mustNotInclude: any employer, tool, team size or number not in the resume
